where: Saltreach Fen II (the deep channels and lantern-reeds, past the Tidecall boundary)
mood: The same fen lonelier and further in — a boat-rocking 6/8 through bone-white mist, one questioning phrase at a time.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
6/8 compound time with a slow rocking lilt
lonely breathy pulse-wave and flute lead, one drifting questioning phrase every two bars
faint bell-buoy chime arpeggios in triplet lilt
deep slow lilting synth bass rocking like a moored boat
percussion only a soft noise-wash swell like moving mist
haunting, lonely, misty night marsh, between places

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a quiet atmospheric entrance: a mist swell, a distant buoy bell chimes twice, the low bass begins its slow rocking}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lonely melody drifts in: a rising leap that hangs unresolved, answered by a faint bell glint, then a second phrase that asks again; slow and haunting but clearly tuneful}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again an octave lower on a softer woodwind, the bell-buoy chimes now answering each phrase like a call across the channel, pad a touch warmer with the bright Dorian sixth glinting}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the channels open into still deep water, a lantern-reed glow; the bass holds a low pedal while a high bell line climbs slowly through B minor and back, very spacious}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the drifting melody returns, and this time its settle-home phrase finally falls to D; the last bar rocks straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
